newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan Synthetic, DSM Engineering to set up venture.
newsitem.headline: Japan Synthetic, DSM Engineering to set up venture.

text.p: Japan Synthetic Rubber Co Ltd and DSM Engineering Plastics BV, a unit of DSM NV, said on Wednesday that they would set up a joint venture in Japan to develop and market engineering plastics.
The new firm, DSM JSR Engineering Plastics KK, is expected to start operating on April 1. The firm will be capitalised at 125 million yen, the companies said in a joint statement.
The new firm will be 51 percent owned by DSM Engineering Plastics and the rest by Japan Synthetic Rubber, the statement said.

In conjunction with the establishment of the venture with Japan Synthetic Rubber, DSM Engineering Plastics will end its cooperation with Japanese manufacturers Teijin Ltd and Unitika Ltd on its Stanyl synthetic rubber.
Engineering plastics are used in electric appliances, automobiles and other products, the statement said.
